description: This file defines the OrderFacade interface, which declares methods related to order processing, calculation, validation, and retrieval in an e-commerce context.

methods.name: initializeOrder
methods.description: Initializes a new order for a specific store, customer, shopping cart, and language.

methods.name: refreshOrder
methods.description: Updates an existing order with current customer, store, shopping cart, and language details.

methods.name: calculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total summary for an order, with overloads for different order input types.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes and validates an order, converting a ShopOrder into a finalized Order.

methods.name: initEmptyCustomer
methods.description: Creates an empty customer object for anonymous users.

methods.name: getShipToCountry
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries where shipping is available for the store.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Calculates a shipping quote based on customer, cart, order, store, and language.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Creates a shipping summary from a shipping quote for order total calculations.

methods.name: validateOrder
methods.description: Validates an order, collecting validation results and messages.

methods.name: getReadableOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a readable version of an order by its ID.

methods.name: getReadableOrderList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of readable orders for a customer or store with pagination.
